links.comparator_used: Un-augmented GPT-4-turbo without guidelines in the prompt
links.outcome: Proportion of vignettes where the model's choice matched the expert-designated optimal next-step pharmacotherapy
links.effect: Augmented model 508/1000 (50.8%, 95% CI 47.7-53.9%; kappa 0.31) vs un-augmented 234 (23.0%, 95% CI 20.8-26.0%); McNemar's p < 0.001. Un-augmented model performance was similar to community clinicians (23.1%).
links.tradeoff: In the augmented model, at least one model choice was among the poor or contraindicated treatments for 120 vignettes (12.0%).
links.quote: By comparison, an un-augmented model identified the optimal treatment for 234 (23.0%, 95% CI 20.8-26.0%; McNemar's p < 0.001 versus augmented model) of the vignettes.
